dept.dentistry.name: Department of Dentistry
dept.dentistry.head_speech: I am pleased and honored to welcome you to the Department of Dentistry at Al-Amarah University College—an academic institution that, since its establishment, has strived to provide high-quality university education that keeps pace with scientific advances and responds to the needs of the community in our beloved city of Amarah. The Department of Dentistry is one of the most vital departments in the college, playing an essential role in preparing qualified medical professionals equipped with the scientific knowledge, practical skills, and professional ethics required to practice dentistry with efficiency and responsibility. The department works to provide an integrated educational environment that combines theoretical study with practical training inside laboratories and teaching clinics, with a commitment to utilizing modern diagnostic and therapeutic technologies. Furthermore, the department places special emphasis on enhancing students' research capabilities and encouraging scientific thinking and teamwork, helping shape doctors capable of keeping pace with scientific progress while serving patients on solid human and professional foundations. Our vision in the Department of Dentistry stems from our belief that medical education is not merely the transmission of knowledge, but a mission and a responsibility toward society. Guided by this principle, we aim to graduate competent dentists who actively contribute to improving healthcare standards and promoting health awareness in Amarah and across all governorates of our beloved Iraq. We pray to Almighty God for everyone's success in their academic and professional journeys.
dept.dentistry.vision: The Department of Dentistry at Al-Amarah University College strives to be a distinguished academic center in dental education and training, occupying an advanced position among peer departments at both the local and national levels. The department's vision stems from the belief in the importance of combining solid scientific foundations with practical clinical application, ensuring the preparation of competent dentists capable of keeping pace with rapid scientific and technological developments in this vital field. Furthermore, the department aspires to contribute to improving oral healthcare standards in the city of Amarah and neighboring areas by graduating medical staff who are fully aware of their professional and humanitarian responsibilities. Central to its vision, the department emphasizes promoting scientific research, remaining open to modern expertise, and cultivating a stimulating educational environment that supports creativity and critical thinking. This aligns with the requirements of society and the labor market while reinforcing the college's role in community service and sustainable healthcare development.
dept.dentistry.mission:
The mission of the Department of Dentistry at Al-Amarah University College is to provide an integrated university education that balances theoretical knowledge with practical application, relying on the latest scientific curricula and accredited clinical technologies in dentistry.
The department works to prepare graduates who possess the scientific knowledge, clinical skills, and professional values required to deliver safe and effective oral healthcare to the people of Amarah and the wider Iraqi community.
Furthermore, the department is committed to fostering a culture of scientific research and rigorous academic practice, encouraging both students and faculty members to engage in scientific and developmental activities. The department's mission also seeks to instill professional ethics, promote a sense of humanitarian responsibility, and foster teamwork—ensuring the graduation of dentists who can interact positively with patients and society while actively contributing to the advancement of healthcare standards.
dept.dentistry.goals: Preparing scientifically and practically qualified dentists who possess diagnostic, therapeutic, and preventive skills in accordance with accredited medical standards. Developing students' clinical capabilities through structured practical training, connecting theoretical knowledge with real-world application. Supporting scientific research and encouraging studies that contribute to solving prevalent oral health issues in the city of Amarah and surrounding regions. Enhancing scientific cooperation with health and academic institutions while fostering communication and teamwork skills among students. Instilling ethical and professional values to build responsible doctors capable of serving the community with competence and humanity, aligning with the college's mission and future aspirations.
dept.dentistry.about: The Department of Dentistry at Al-Amarah University College is one of the vital medical departments dedicated to advancing the healthcare sector in the city of Amarah and the governorate as a whole. The department focuses on preparing dentists who possess a solid scientific foundation and advanced clinical skills, enabling them to provide high-quality therapeutic and preventive services in accordance with accredited scientific and ethical standards. In its educational programs, the department integrates theoretical knowledge with practical application through modern laboratories and teaching clinics that provide students with early hands-on training, building their confidence and expertise. Additionally, the department is committed to keeping pace with modern developments in dental sciences, encouraging students to engage in scientific research and stay updated on global advances in the field. The Department of Dentistry places special emphasis on community service by promoting oral health awareness and participating in educational and treatment campaigns, reflecting the college's mission to serve and develop the local community.
dept.pharmacy.name: Department of Pharmacy
dept.pharmacy.head_speech:
Dear students, my esteemed colleagues among the faculty and staff, and honorable visitors: I am deeply pleased, honored, and delighted to welcome you to the website of the Department of Pharmacy at Al-Amarah University College. 
 I am thrilled to welcome you all to this outstanding department, which brings together some of the finest minds and brightest talents in the field of pharmacy. Your decision to join us reflects your dedication to building a promising future in healthcare and pharmaceutical care. 
 In the Department of Pharmacy, we strive to provide an inspiring and stimulating learning environment that empowers you to discover your potential and develop your skills. We are committed to delivering comprehensive, practice-oriented educational programs that equip you with the academic knowledge and practical skills necessary to achieve excellence in the field. 
 Together, as one team, we will work to provide a fruitful and engaging educational experience. You will have the opportunity to engage with distinguished faculty members specialized in various branches of pharmacy, as well as opportunities to participate in rigorous research and development projects that enhance your skills and deepen your expertise.
 We are here to support you in reaching your academic and professional goals. We welcome your ideas, challenges, and aspirations, and we assure you of our continuous guidance and support. 
 I look forward to witnessing your growth and development throughout your studies in the Department of Pharmacy. I encourage you to make the most of all the resources and opportunities the department offers. 
 Once again, welcome, and I wish you an inspiring and successful academic journey! 
 Best regards.
dept.pharmacy.vision: Pharmacy is a vital and essential discipline that plays an effective role in societal development and improving people's quality of life. In this context, Al-Amarah University College offers the Department of Pharmacy as a specialized department aimed at equipping students with comprehensive knowledge and skills in pharmaceutical sciences. The department instills the ethics of the pharmacy profession, promotes the values of self-directed and lifelong learning, and conducts advanced scientific research that contributes to drug development and meets the community's healthcare needs. The department aspires to be a pioneer in pharmaceutical education both locally and globally, across academic and professional domains. The Department of Pharmacy at Al-Amarah University College serves as a platform empowering students to practice pharmacy professionally and make meaningful contributions to their community.
dept.pharmacy.mission: Achieving excellence in the field of pharmacy by training and developing distinguished pharmaceutical personnel, with a focus on all elements required to prepare highly competent graduates who possess deep knowledge across all aspects of pharmaceutical practice in its diverse domains. Providing outstanding pharmaceutical education through accredited academic programs to qualify highly competent pharmacists capable of contributing to the improvement of community healthcare and competing in professional markets nationally and regionally. The department is dedicated to instilling the ethics of the pharmacy profession, fostering values of self-directed and lifelong learning, and conducting advanced scientific research that contributes to the development of the pharmaceutical industry and meets societal health needs. The department aspires to be a pioneer in pharmaceutical education both locally and globally across academic and professional fields. It aims to ensure that its graduates are theoretically and practically distinguished by offering top-tier educational programs in the pharmaceutical and medical fields, with a strong emphasis on practical education to prepare leaders in pharmaceutical manufacturing and clinical pharmacy, providing the labor market with specialized scientific expertise in the field of pharmacy.
dept.pharmacy.goals: Graduating specialized professional pharmaceutical personnel and developing distinguished educational programs. Qualifying students by providing comprehensive, specialized educational programs that enable them to acquire the knowledge and skills necessary to practice pharmacy successfully. Empowering students to understand drug synthesis methods, mechanisms of action, chemical structures, and therapeutic applications. Striving to achieve international quality standards in pharmaceutical education and pursuing academic accreditation. Adopting advanced teaching methodologies. Enhancing the pharmacist's role in healthcare and disease prevention while building their scientific capabilities to fulfill this role effectively. Encouraging faculty and students to engage in scientific research across various pharmaceutical fields to advance knowledge and innovation. Exchanging scientific and research expertise with regional and international specialized universities and institutions. Providing state-of-the-art scientific laboratories built to internationally accredited specifications.
dept.pharmacy.about: The Department of Pharmacy is an academic, applied, and scientific department established in 2023 with the approval of the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research. Recognizing the urgent need in Maysan Governorate, Al-Amarah University College took it upon itself to establish the department. Following detailed feasibility studies and the provision of the required physical and human resources in accordance with the Ministry’s guidelines, official approval was granted under Ministry Letter No. 17663 to admit graduates of the preparatory school (Scientific and Biology branches) based on official admission regulations. Upon the successful completion of a five-year program, the department awards a Bachelor’s Degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences. The college has been keen to recruit specialized faculty members known for their scientific competence and research capability. Additionally, the college has fully equipped the department with the necessary instruments, equipment, and materials to ensure the smooth operation of the educational process, equipping students with essential skills and preparing them effectively for the labor market and community service.
dept.radiology.name: Radiology and Sonography Techniques Department
dept.radiology.head_speech: The Head of the Radiology and Sonography Techniques Department at Al-Amarah University College is pleased to extend a warm welcome to students and those interested in the medical and technical fields. The department focuses on providing an integrated educational environment that merges theoretical knowledge with practical application, aiming to prepare specialists capable of operating the latest radiology and ultrasound equipment and technologies with precision and efficiency. The department strives to develop students' skills in medical diagnosis, image analysis, and performing examinations to the highest standards of accuracy, while fostering critical thinking and problem-solving abilities. It is also committed to instilling professional and ethical values in students, promoting scientific research, and enhancing collaboration with local hospitals and health centers. The department’s programs aim to keep pace with modern technological advancements, ensuring that graduates are well-equipped to deliver accurate and reliable medical services—contributing to higher healthcare quality and strengthening the medical standing of both Al-Amarah University College and the city of Amarah.
dept.radiology.vision: The Radiology and Sonography Techniques Department at Al-Amarah University College aspires to be a center of excellence in education and scientific research, keeping pace with modern technological and medical advancements. The department aims to prepare specialists capable of utilizing state-of-the-art diagnostic equipment and techniques with accuracy and efficiency, contributing to the enhancement of healthcare quality. Furthermore, it seeks to foster innovation, strengthen scientific research, and expand collaboration with hospitals and healthcare centers—elevating medical performance in the city of Amarah and surrounding regions while empowering the local community with highly qualified, trusted professionals.
dept.radiology.mission: The department’s mission is to provide an integrated education that combines theoretical knowledge with practical application in radiology and ultrasound techniques. The department focuses on developing students' skills in conducting examinations and analyzing medical images with high precision, while fostering critical thinking and scientific problem-solving. Furthermore, the department seeks to support scientific research, collaborate with the medical community and hospitals, and instill professional and ethical values—ensuring the preparation of graduates capable of delivering accurate and reliable diagnostic services that contribute to improving healthcare in the city of Amarah.
dept.radiology.goals:
*Preparing specialized graduates in radiology and ultrasound techniques.
*Enhancing scientific research and innovation in the medical field.
Developing educational programs that keep pace with modern technological advancements.
Supporting collaboration between the department, local hospitals, and healthcare centers.
Instilling professional and ethical values in students to improve the quality of medical services.
Contributing to the enhancement of healthcare and community service in the city of Amarah and surrounding regions.
dept.radiology.about: The Radiology and Sonography Techniques Department at Al-Amarah University College is one of the leading departments dedicated to preparing specialists capable of keeping pace with modern advancements in medical diagnostics. The department focuses on providing an integrated educational environment that combines theoretical knowledge with practical application, emphasizing the development of students' skills in operating radiology and ultrasound equipment, as well as analyzing medical images with high accuracy and efficiency. The department seeks to foster critical thinking, enhance scientific problem-solving, and instill professional and ethical values in students, ensuring their readiness to meet the workplace challenges of hospitals and health centers. Furthermore, the department places great importance on scientific research and collaboration with local healthcare institutions to improve medical care quality and serve the community. Through advanced educational and research programs, the department works to prepare qualified graduates who can deliver accurate and reliable diagnostic services, contributing to public health enhancement and elevating the status of both Al-Amarah University College and the city of Amarah in the field of radiology and modern medical techniques.
dept.dental_industry.name: Dental Technology Department
dept.dental_industry.head_speech:
The academic department represents the core unit within the university’s organizational structure, as no university can fulfill its mission and achieve its objectives except through its academic departments. Therefore, the Dental Technology Department strives to be an administrative unit characterized by distinct attributes and noble goals, strictly and faithfully implementing ministry laws, instructions, and regulations in a manner that positively impacts the department’s outcomes by producing highly skilled, specialized personnel.
The department's philosophy centers on establishing an outstanding center for practical and academic dental technology, capable of delivering the highest global standards of quality in teaching, training, and scientific research for students—ultimately meeting the needs of the community.'
The ambition of the Dental Technology Department is to graduate dental technicians who excel both scientifically and practically, enhancing their capabilities to keep pace with rapid scientific progress in service of the nation. This is achieved by training them on the latest technologies and equipment while refining their skills in the field of dental technology.
The Dental Technology Department began admitting students in the 2021–2022 academic year, working diligently to establish all prerequisites for scientific excellence. This includes providing specialized faculty members across various medical disciplines and academic ranks who work with dedication to elevate the students' academic standard, alongside modernizing university teaching methods and advancing scientific research.
dept.dental_industry.vision: The Department of Dental Technology envisions becoming one of the leading scientific departments, keeping pace with the latest scientific advancements in the field of dental technology. It aspires to qualify highly competent, specialized graduates with advanced practical experience, equipped with the ability to understand and apply all modern technologies in this domain.
dept.dental_industry.mission: Today, dental technology stands at the forefront of modern scientific discoveries. Consequently, the department strives to harness these advancements to prepare qualified personnel capable of fulfilling this mission and continuously enhancing their professional performance.
dept.dental_industry.goals:
To achieve this vision, the following objectives must be fulfilled:

*Introducing students to dental technology laboratories and the correct operation of the equipment, machinery, and tools used within them.
*Educating students on various dental materials used in the field of dental technology.
*Instructing students on all occupational safety requirements.
Enabling students to master the fabrication of various fixed dental prostheses, including crowns, bridges, cosmetic veneers, and implant-supported crowns.
*Teaching students how to construct removable prostheses, whether complete or partial, using acrylic or metallic materials.
*Training students on the design and fabrication of various maxillofacial prostheses.
*Instructing students in the fabrication of removable orthodontic appliances.
dept.dental_industry.about: Academic studies in the Department of Dental Technology began in the 2021–2022 academic year with the admission of its first cohort of 17 male and female students. The department works to prepare scientifically qualified medical personnel capable of understanding, managing, and innovating in dental technology operations following a four-year undergraduate program, after which students graduate as Medical Dental Technologists.
dept.cosmetic_laser.name: Cosmetic and Laser Technology Department
dept.cosmetic_laser.head_speech:
I am pleased to welcome you to the Department of Cosmetology and Laser Techniques, a department established as a scientific and practical institution to keep pace with rapid advancements in medical aesthetics and modern laser technologies. Our vision stems from a firm belief in combining theoretical knowledge with rigorous practical training, qualifying our students to become competent professionals capable of meeting job market demands and serving society with efficiency and responsibility.
The department is committed to providing a modern educational environment supported by advanced scientific curricula, laboratories equipped with state-of-the-art technologies, and a specialized faculty possessing extensive academic and practical experience. Furthermore, we place great emphasis on professional ethics and patient safety, encouraging students to adhere to globally recognized scientific and professional standards.
The role of the Department of Cosmetology and Laser Techniques extends beyond education; it actively contributes to scientific research and community service through workshops, training courses, and awareness initiatives. We hope our graduates serve as role models of competence, discipline, and innovation, making meaningful contributions to the advancement of this vital field in service of humanity and society.
dept.cosmetic_laser.vision: The Department of Cosmetology and Laser Techniques aspires to be a distinguished and leading academic department in applied education and scientific research related to modern aesthetic techniques and medical laser applications—keeping pace with rapid scientific advancements and meeting the needs of society and the labor market. The department’s vision is rooted in the belief that it is essential to prepare qualified professionals possessing both theoretical knowledge and practical skills required to work with high efficiency and professionalism, alongside a firm commitment to academic and ethical values in professional practice. Furthermore, the department aims to enhance its scientific stature locally and regionally by developing curricula, adopting modern teaching methodologies focused on practical training and clinical application, and encouraging innovation and scientific research. The department firmly believes that excellence is achieved through a stimulating educational environment that fosters creativity, keeps pace with scientific and technological developments in aesthetics and lasers, and contributes to improving the quality of health and cosmetic services provided to the community. Additionally, the department’s vision encompasses building scientific and professional partnerships with healthcare and educational institutions, expanding opportunities for continuous development, and strengthening the department’s role in community service and sustainable development.
dept.cosmetic_laser.mission: The mission of the Department of Cosmetology and Laser Techniques is to deliver rigorous academic and practical education aimed at preparing scientifically and technically qualified graduates in the fields of aesthetics and laser applications, who are capable of practicing the profession with efficiency and responsibility in accordance with accredited scientific and ethical standards. The department is committed to offering balanced educational programs that integrate theoretical knowledge with practical training, emphasizing the development of students' skills and enhancing their analytical thinking and professional problem-solving abilities. Furthermore, the department strives to support scientific research and encourage students and faculty members to conduct applied studies that contribute to advancing the field and enhancing the quality of cosmetic services. A central priority of the department's mission is community service, fulfilled through promoting health and aesthetic awareness and addressing the needs of healthcare and cosmetic facilities by providing qualified professionals. The department reinforces its dedication to the continuous development of curricula and teaching methodologies while leveraging modern technologies, ensuring the graduation of competent professionals equipped to keep pace with scientific and technological progress and serve society with high efficiency and professionalism.
dept.cosmetic_laser.goals: Preparing specialized technical personnel possessing strong scientific foundations and practical skills in cosmetology and laser fields, capable of working efficiently in healthcare and cosmetic institutions. Continuously updating academic curricula to align with modern scientific and technological advancements while enhancing practical training for students. Developing students' research capabilities and encouraging innovation and participation in scientific activities that advance the field. Promoting professional ethics and ensuring adherence to health and occupational safety standards during practical application. Establishing collaborative partnerships with healthcare and cosmetic facilities to provide field training opportunities that refine student skills and bridge academia with the job market. Serving the community by organizing scientific and awareness activities that elevate health and aesthetic standards while actively contributing to sustainable development.
dept.cosmetic_laser.about: The Department of Cosmetology and Laser Techniques is one of the modern scientific departments established in response to the rapid developments in skincare, medical aesthetics, and laser-based therapeutic technologies. The department aims to prepare qualified personnel possessing the necessary theoretical knowledge and practical skills to work in cosmetic centers, medical clinics, and related healthcare institutions, adhering to rigorous scientific foundations and accredited professional standards. The department’s academic programs rely on a balanced integration of theoretical lectures and hands-on training within laboratories equipped with the latest devices and technologies, ensuring a direct connection between academic principles and real-world practical application. Furthermore, the department continuously follows the latest scientific and technological advancements in cosmetology and lasers, updating its curricula to align with job market demands. The department strives to promote professional ethics, foster a sense of responsibility among students, and encourage continuous learning and research. These efforts ensure the delivery of safe and effective cosmetic services that serve the community and advance the healthcare and aesthetic sectors.
dept.medical_lab.name: Medical Laboratory Sciences Department
dept.medical_lab.head_speech: The Head of the Department of Pathological Analysis Sciences at Al-Amarah University College is pleased to welcome you to an advanced educational and research environment dedicated to preparing outstanding specialists in laboratory analysis and medical research. The department is committed to equipping students with modern scientific knowledge and practical skills in operating laboratory equipment and analyzing samples with high precision, while fostering critical thinking and scientific problem-solving. Furthermore, we encourage strict adherence to professional and ethical values and actively support scientific research through collaboration with local hospitals and healthcare centers. The department’s academic programs aim to keep pace with modern medical and technological developments, ensuring that our students deliver accurate and reliable analytical services that contribute to improving healthcare and reinforcing the academic standing of both Al-Amarah University College and the city of Amarah in medical sciences.
dept.medical_lab.vision: The Department of Pathological Analysis Sciences at Al-Amarah University College aspires to be an outstanding center for education and scientific research, focusing on innovation and precision in laboratory practice. The department aims to prepare graduates capable of delivering reliable diagnostic services, contributing to healthcare enhancement, and promoting public health. Furthermore, it seeks to build sustainable partnerships with local and international hospitals and healthcare centers to support scientific research and advance modern laboratory techniques—ultimately elevating both academic and community standards in the city of Amarah and surrounding areas.
dept.medical_lab.mission: The department's mission is to provide an integrated education that combines theoretical knowledge with practical application in pathological analysis sciences. The department focuses on developing students' skills in operating modern laboratory equipment and analyzing samples with high precision, while fostering critical thinking and problem-solving abilities. Furthermore, the department seeks to support scientific research, collaborate with the medical and healthcare community, and instill professional and ethical values—aiming to prepare specialists capable of delivering accurate and reliable healthcare services that serve the community and support healthcare development in the city of Amarah.
dept.medical_lab.goals:
*Qualifying graduates prepared to work in medical laboratories and hospitals.
*Enhancing scientific research and innovation in the field of laboratory analysis.
*Developing educational programs that align with modern medical and technological advancements.
*Supporting collaboration with local healthcare centers and the community.
*Instilling professional and ethical values in students to improve the quality of healthcare services.
*Contributing to the enhancement of healthcare and promoting public health in the city of Amarah and surrounding areas.
dept.medical_lab.about: The Department of Pathological Analysis Sciences at Al-Amarah University College is one of the leading departments dedicated to preparing specialists capable of addressing modern scientific and medical challenges. The department focuses on developing students' skills in laboratory analysis, operating advanced equipment, and interpreting results with high precision. It actively encourages critical thinking and scientific problem-solving, alongside a strong commitment to professional and ethical values. Furthermore, the department is keen on enhancing scientific research and fostering collaboration with local hospitals and healthcare centers to elevate the quality of healthcare. Through its advanced educational and research programs, the department aims to prepare qualified graduates who support public health and reinforce the academic standing of both Al-Amarah University College and the city of Amarah in the field of medical sciences.
dept.petroleum_eng.name: Petroleum Engineering Department
dept.petroleum_eng.head_speech:
The Department of Petroleum Engineering at Al-Amarah University College is one of the emerging academic departments in Iraqi universities and colleges, having begun admitting students seeking specialization in petroleum engineering during the 2018–2019 academic year. Despite its recent establishment, the department holds ambitious goals to become a distinguished petroleum engineering department—first nationally across Iraq, and second regionally. It aims to achieve this by graduating competent petroleum engineers capable of competing effectively in the labor market across all specializations related to petroleum studies and operations, including drilling, exploration, reservoir engineering, and production.
Furthermore, the department aspires to play a vital role in conducting and publishing scientific research, as well as organizing workshops, seminars, scientific conferences, and training courses. These activities are of paramount importance in fostering scientific collaboration between various academic institutions and companies operating in the oil sector.
The department works to realize its ambitions by selecting distinguished Iraqi and Arab academic faculty, building a robust laboratory infrastructure equipped with advanced educational and research technologies, and actively pursuing collaboration with petroleum departments, institutions, and companies operating within the country. This integration ensures that theoretical academic studies are seamlessly connected to field-based practical realities.
Through these combined efforts, the Department of Petroleum Engineering at Al-Amarah University College aims to fulfill its national duty of supplying the region with specialized, highly qualified scientific personnel.
dept.petroleum_eng.vision: Fulfilling the department’s mission and objectives—to shape a petroleum engineer with an outstanding scientific and professional profile—requires inspiring students toward creativity and excellence. It involves fostering their scientific personality, building strong academic and social communication skills, and enhancing their capacity to effectively solve real-world engineering challenges in their field.
dept.petroleum_eng.mission: The department's mission is to graduate qualified, distinguished petroleum engineers capable of demonstrating excellence across all fields of petroleum engineering.
dept.petroleum_eng.goals:
The objectives of the Department of Petroleum Engineering at Al-Amarah University College are as follows:
*Preparing highly qualified petroleum engineers with advanced scientific training across various petroleum specializations, enabling them to compete strongly in the labor market and contribute effectively to national development.
*Continuously developing faculty capabilities by organizing and participating in scientific seminars, training courses, and workshops, as well as recruiting distinguished academic talent to the department.
*Conducting rigorous scientific research, with a particular focus on applied studies that can be directly utilized within the industry.
*Instilling core values and principles in students that contribute to community development while fostering their academic and professional growth.
*Achieving the highest level of collaboration and engagement between the department, peer academic departments, and key institutions across the petroleum industry.
dept.petroleum_eng.about:
Petroleum engineering, across its various domains, stands as one of the most vital disciplines globally—a significance that is particularly elevated in oil-producing nations where it serves as a driving force and cornerstone of the national economy. Iraq represents one of the world's most prominent energy nations, possessing immense oil wealth upon which its economy primarily relies. Consequently, establishing academic departments and colleges specialized in petroleum engineering is of paramount importance to prepare qualified engineers capable of exploring, producing, and optimizing these resources effectively, while creating high-value employment opportunities and reducing reliance on foreign expertise.
Globally, interest in petroleum engineering programs has surged as easily accessible, shallow energy reserves face depletion. Modern petroleum exploration, extraction, and production now demand high-level skills, advanced technical competence, and specialized knowledge, necessitating the expansion of specialized institutes, faculties, research centers, and academic departments in oil-producing regions.
Established alongside the founding of Al-Amarah University College, the Department of Petroleum Engineering admitted its inaugural cohort during the 2018–2019 academic year. Located in a region renowned for its vast energy resources, the department addresses a key national objective: preparing competent petroleum engineers while providing accessible, high-quality higher education for students from Maysan Governorate and across Iraq. This local academic access relieves families of the financial and logistical burdens associated with studying far from home or abroad, ultimately preserving financial resources within the country.
dept.mechanical_eng.name: Power Mechanics Engineering Technology Department
dept.mechanical_eng.head_speech:
In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
I am pleased to welcome you to the Department of Power Mechanics Engineering Technology, one of the foundational departments at Al-Amarah University College since its establishment in 2017.
The department awards a Bachelor’s degree in Power Mechanics Engineering Technology, qualifying graduates for a wide array of applied career paths. These encompass mechanical construction and structural engineering, systems maintenance, the petroleum industry, manufacturing and machining workshops, power generation plants, automotive engineering, and HVAC systems development.
To execute its educational program, the department relies on a highly qualified specialized faculty and technical staff, supported by modern laboratories and advanced equipment sourced from renowned global manufacturers.
Prioritizing alignment with labor market requirements, the department equips students with essential knowledge and practical skills across these key specializations. We strive to graduate engineers who possess strong scientific capabilities and practical expertise to meet the demands of both public and private industrial sectors. Furthermore, we actively foster a culture of innovation, creativity, and self-directed learning to keep pace with rapid technological advancements.
In line with the overarching vision of the college, the department seeks to establish collaborative relationships with corresponding faculties, technical departments, and engineering institutions within Iraq and internationally through academic visits, seminars, and conferences. We are equally committed to expanding practical learning opportunities by coordinating scientific field visits and engineering training programs for our students locally and abroad.
Thank you for visiting our department, and we welcome your insights and feedback to continually support our development and performance.
May Allah grant us success.
dept.mechanical_eng.vision: The Department of Power Mechanics Engineering Technology was established in 2018 in response to the country's urgent need for technical engineers specialized in power mechanics, supporting efforts to keep pace with rapid scientific and technological advancements in the field.
dept.mechanical_eng.mission:
*Preparing and graduating an engineering workforce equipped with key technical and cognitive requirements to serve as a high-quality engineering and technical resource in power mechanics.
*Reinforcing the principle of community engagement to promote technical education and its practical applications.
*Graduating skilled and confident scientific teams proficient in manufacturing, repair, control, and maintenance of relevant equipment.
*Organizing training and qualification courses led by competent faculty with student participation to support labor market integration.
*Strengthening academic and administrative relations with corresponding scientific and engineering faculties, as well as relevant ministries, industrial companies, and institutions, regarding educational needs, retraining, and curriculum development.
*Establishing and continuously refining academic and administrative plans and curricula required to achieve the above objectives, while actively monitoring feedback to optimize planning and curriculum performance.
dept.mechanical_eng.goals:
*Knowledge, understanding, and evaluation of economic feasibility studies for projects within the specialization.
*Capability to diagnose faults and supervise maintenance and repair operations.
*Ability to collaborate with specialists in conducting research on energy conservation and developing alternative energy solutions in the field.
*Proficiency in operating modern diagnostic equipment and advanced testing machinery within the specialization.
dept.mechanical_eng.about:
Mechanical engineering is one of the most vital engineering disciplines, distinguished by the diversity and breadth of its applications in daily life. Through their efficient work across these domains, mechanical engineers actively contribute to the development and advancement of human progress.
Among the most key applications are heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and refrigeration (HVAC&R); power generation and transmission; land, marine, and aerospace transportation; hoisting and conveying systems; mechanical equipment; steam boilers; heat exchangers; piping networks, pipelines, and storage facilities; nuclear reactors; biomedical engineering and medical devices; building services engineering, environmental pollution, and control equipment; vibration and acoustics engineering; automotive engineering; turbomachinery; space exploration; and marine exploration, among many others.
The Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering awarded to students serves as their gateway into a future professional, technical, or academic career. It empowers graduates to apply the knowledge acquired throughout their years of study to address the varied challenges they will encounter. Crucially, earning this degree does not automatically make one a successful mechanical engineer; rather, it signifies that the graduate possesses the potential to become a successful engineer by utilizing structured scientific and engineering thinking alongside the core knowledge gained during their studies.
Here in the Department of Mechanical Engineering, we are firmly committed to this philosophy, striving to achieve its goals within our available human and material resources. Our goal is to graduate competent engineering personnel who, through active engagement with society and public institutions, can serve the nation across all relevant fields, particularly within the aforementioned applications.
dept.medical_devices_eng.name: Medical Instrumentation Engineering Technology Department
dept.medical_devices_eng.head_speech:
On behalf of myself, the faculty, and the staff of the Department of Medical Instrumentation Engineering Technology at Al-Amarah University College in Amarah, I would like to welcome you to the official website of Al-Amarah University College.
Our department was established in 2020 as an educational institution in the field of medical instrumentation technology in Iraq, operating under the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research and the Commission of Technical Education.
We believe that every student enters college with a dream of a promising future. From their very first day in our department, we are dedicated to helping them build that dream and empowering them to create a meaningful, transformative impact in their community. We instill this drive in those who possess passion, creativity, and ambition. This commitment defines our spirit and culture in the Department of Medical Instrumentation Engineering Technology at Al-Amarah University College as we strive to achieve excellence in engineering and education to support effective healthcare for all.
Vision:To be a leading technical educational department providing high-quality programs aligned with global scientific advancements and technical skills.
Mission:
To embody the ethics of technical education by delivering high-quality technical instruction that develops human knowledge and skills in step with environmental and societal changes.
*Attaining international standards in medical and health technical education.
*Adapting to workplace developments through healthcare programs that keep pace with evolving technologies in therapeutic and preventive environments.
*Preparing qualified engineering personnel equipped with the knowledge and practical skills required to navigate technological progress in the global workplace.
*Providing an optimal learning environment to maximize academic and practical achievement.
*Emphasizing self-respect and mutual respect for others.
*Continuously monitoring and integrating developments across various branches of medical and health engineering.
*Upholding academic traditions, professional ethics, and values.
dept.medical_devices_eng.head_name: Lecturer Dr. Kamal Jassim Shaalan Al-Budairi
dept.medical_devices_eng.vision:
To qualify distinguished and innovative professionals, technically and behaviorally skilled in medical equipment technology, while keeping pace with corresponding departments in reputable global universities by delivering community services and offering modern curricula that foster an advanced academic environment.
The department strives to be among the leading academic departments in Iraq, recognized nationally and internationally for scientific rigor, excellence in education, and impactful research that advances knowledge and serves society through continuous technical support and the graduation of highly competent professionals.
dept.medical_devices_eng.mission:
The mission of the Department of Medical Instrumentation Engineering Technology is to provide students with an advanced educational, technical, and research environment supported by modern curricula that highlight the significance of this specialization. The department is committed to delivering up-to-date scientific curricula, practical laboratories, and applied research that simulate labor market requirements, fostering collaboration with healthcare institutions, and contributing to the elevation of healthcare standards regionally and internationally.
Throughout each academic level, students master essential theories and practical skills aligned with various scientific and industrial sectors, reflecting the core value and impact of this discipline.
dept.medical_devices_eng.goals:
*Equipping students with scientific and practical skills to diagnose faults in medical equipment.
*Preparing competent engineers capable of keeping pace with rapid developments in medical instrumentation and instilling the necessary skills for system development and modernization.
*Providing graduates with comprehensive knowledge of modern technologies in medical instrumentation engineering.
*Ensuring students develop sufficient expertise to perform necessary updates and modifications on medical devices.
*Expanding academically through the future establishment of postgraduate programs for Master’s and Doctoral degrees.
*Installing and operating diagnostic and therapeutic electronic and electromechanical medical devices.
*Supervising and contributing to the routine maintenance, servicing, and calibration of various medical instruments.
*Designing, developing, and sourcing suitable alternative components for medical equipment parts.
*Scheduling and programming periodic maintenance operations.
*Enhancing performance standards through the implementation of international criteria in technical education.
*Continuously updating and aligning curricula with emerging developments in the field.
*Strengthening ties between the college and all sectors of society.
*Fostering active engagement and partnership with peer academic institutions locally and internationally.
dept.medical_devices_eng.about:
Driven by rapid scientific and technological advancements across technical engineering disciplines, the Department of Medical Instrumentation Engineering Technology specifically focuses on the engineering study of the human body, including anatomy and physiology. While diagnosis and treatment planning were historically handled solely by physicians, this discipline emerged to directly support medical practice—positioning medical instrumentation as an essential tool throughout every stage of care, from initial diagnosis to the completion of treatment.
Following the approval of His Excellency the Minister of Higher Education and Scientific Research, the Department of Medical Instrumentation Engineering Technology was established at Al-Amarah University College, welcoming its inaugural class of students in the 2020–2021 academic year.
dept.electrical_eng.name: Electrical Power Engineering Technology Department
dept.electrical_eng.head_speech:
On behalf of myself, I would like to extend my warmest greetings and best wishes to all faculty members and students of the Department of Electrical Power Engineering Technology in particular, and to the entire staff and student body of Al-Amarah University College in general, as we welcome a new academic year. During this time, most of our students advance to a new academic stage following their preparatory education, and we warmly await the new cohort of students who will join our department and college.
We ask Almighty God that this year brings goodness, prosperity, dedication, success, and achievement, as we strive together to elevate the standing of our college across all scientific and academic fields. May God grant us success.
dept.electrical_eng.head_name: Lecturer Dr. Ali Jaleel Taher Sebahi Al-Lami
dept.electrical_eng.vision: The department strives to develop effective, high-performing engineering personnel equipped with core technical, practical, and scientific skills in electrical power engineering to meet society's needs and support the demands of public infrastructure projects, as well as Iraqi and international labor markets. By fulfilling the strategic goals upon which the department was founded, we advance the overarching aspirations of Al-Amarah University College in preparing qualified engineering professionals. Armed with solid theoretical knowledge and practical expertise, our graduates are empowered to drive socioeconomic development, foster technological modernization, and fulfill dynamic labor market requirements.
dept.electrical_eng.mission:
*Preparing and qualifying competent engineers equipped with strong theoretical knowledge and practical expertise aligned with advancements in electrical engineering and labor market demands.
*Strengthening relations with the public and private sectors through scientific exhibitions, workshops, seminars, and field visits tailored to meet industry requirements.
*Keeping pace with global standards in educational curricula and programs, with a strong emphasis on practical applications, innovations, and laboratory experimentation.
*Implementing and utilizing modern engineering software and computational tools to stay aligned with global technological progress.
dept.electrical_eng.goals:
*Qualifying and preparing efficient engineers endowed with strong theoretical and practical expertise, critical thinking capabilities, and high-level technical skills acquired through the department’s academic curriculum.
*Training qualified technical engineering personnel to operate electric power generation and transmission stations, as well as manage and maintain associated electrical and electronic equipment.
*Contributing to solutions for global energy challenges by utilizing and advancing renewable and sustainable energy technologies.
*Establishing collaborative channels, partnerships, and academic twinning programs with reputable international universities.
*Equipping graduates with effective communication, teamwork, and interdisciplinary collaboration skills to work seamlessly with peers across various fields.
*Engaging in scientific and educational dialogue, technical debates, and knowledge exchanges with local and international peer universities in relevant engineering fields.
Enhancing performance standards through the adoption and implementation of international criteria in Electrical Power Engineering Technology.
dept.electrical_eng.about: The Department of Electrical Power Engineering Technology at Al-Amarah University College was established in the 2021–2022 academic year following the fulfillment of all institutional requirements—including teaching faculty, lecture halls, and scientific laboratories—and upon securing official approval from the Iraqi Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research.
dept.chemical_eng.name: Chemical Engineering and Petroleum Industries Department
dept.chemical_eng.head_speech:
Ladies and Gentlemen,
Warm greetings and best wishes to you all. It is my pleasure to address you as the Head of the Department of Chemical Engineering and Petroleum Industries at Al-Amarah University College.
I am pleased to announce that the Department of Chemical Engineering and Petroleum Industries has been newly established as part of our strategy aimed at keeping pace with the rapid developments in the oil, gas, and broader industrial sectors in Iraq and the region. We are witnessing a growing demand for chemical engineers in both local and international markets; thus, establishing this department comes in direct response to these expanding needs.
Students in our department receive rigorous training using state-of-the-art laboratory technologies and software tailored for design, analysis, and industrial operations. We are dedicated to equipping our students with the essential skills and knowledge required to become qualified chemical engineers capable of addressing modern industrial challenges.
Furthermore, we strive to expand the frontiers of knowledge in chemical and petroleum engineering through research and active collaboration with industry leaders and global academic institutions. We believe in the vital role of scientific research in advancing the oil and gas sector and optimizing associated industrial processes. To that end, we welcome strategic partnerships with corporations and institutions to achieve these shared goals.
In conclusion, I would like to express my pride and honor in leading this modern and evolving department. I look forward to witnessing the growth and future success of our students and graduates. I thank you all for your kind presence and ongoing support.
Thank you, and warm regards to everyone.
dept.chemical_eng.head_name: Assistant Professor Dr. Murtadha Sadoon Mohammad
dept.chemical_eng.vision: The Department of Chemical Engineering and Petroleum Industries aims to qualify and empower students to become distinguished engineers in the fields of chemical and petroleum engineering. We strive to provide an inspiring and stimulating educational environment that enhances technical knowledge, practical skills, and leadership initiative. Our efforts center on fostering innovation, research, and hands-on learning, while actively strengthening industry engagement and deploying sustainable technologies to address global challenges.
dept.chemical_eng.mission: Our vision is to be a globally recognized center of excellence in education, research, and industry partnerships within chemical engineering and petroleum industries. We strive to empower students with the essential knowledge and skills needed to tackle complex challenges, lead technological advancements, and make a positive impact on society and the environment. Additionally, we aim to expand the frontiers of knowledge in chemical and petroleum engineering through research and collaboration with industry leaders and global academic institutions.
dept.chemical_eng.goals:
*Enhancing Educational Programs: Refining and updating curricula to dynamically respond to industry needs and modern technological advancements, while strengthening hands-on training and practical skills for students.
*Promoting Research and Development: Increasing support for research within chemical engineering and petroleum industries, and fostering collaboration with industry partners, academic institutions, and government bodies to conduct innovative research and develop sustainable technologies.
*Building Industrial Partnerships: Expanding and strengthening relationships with corporations and organizations across the chemical engineering and petroleum sectors. Developing targeted training programs and educational opportunities that enable students to engage directly with industry and gain invaluable practical experience.
*Encouraging Innovation and Entrepreneurship: Cultivating a culture of creativity and innovation among students, encouraging them to develop independent projects and transform conceptual ideas into successful commercial products.
*Advancing Sustainable Technologies: Raising awareness regarding the importance of sustainable development and the application of eco-friendly technologies within chemical engineering and petroleum processes. Encouraging research and innovations aimed at improving environmental efficiency and mitigating negative ecological impacts.
*Fostering Lifelong Learning: Providing continuous learning and professional development opportunities for faculty members, students, and practicing engineers in chemical and petroleum engineering. Developing online and distance learning programs designed to deepen knowledge and advance specialized skill sets.
dept.chemical_eng.about:
The Department of Chemical Engineering and Petroleum Industries at Al-Amarah University College was established in 2022, granting graduates a Bachelor of Science degree in Chemical Engineering and Petroleum Industries. The establishment of this department aligns with the rapid expansion of the oil, gas, and broader industrial sectors in Iraq and the region, addressing the growing demand for qualified chemical engineers in both local and global labor markets.
Chemical engineering studies focus on the design and development of chemical conversion processes and the manufacturing of chemical products, including petrochemicals, fertilizers, pharmaceuticals, fuels, plastics, and synthetic rubbers. The Department of Chemical Engineering and Petroleum Industries emphasizes the development of technologies for the exploration, production, and refining of crude oil, along with separation processes, refining techniques, and product marketing.
The academic curriculum covers core disciplines such as organic chemistry, physical chemistry, fluid mechanics, separation processes, petroleum refining, reactor design, automated process control, and plant design. Students receive comprehensive training using modern tools, software, and laboratory technologies essential for industrial design, analysis, and operations.
Graduates enjoy diverse career opportunities across the oil, gas, chemical, petrochemical, and renewable energy sectors. Areas of specialization include crude oil processing, petrochemical manufacturing, petroleum refining, natural gas processing, renewable energy systems, materials science, and environmental engineering.
dept.cybersecurity_eng.name: Cybersecurity Engineering Technology Department
dept.cybersecurity_eng.head_speech:
In the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful
It is my distinct pleasure and honor to welcome you to the Department of Cybersecurity Engineering Technology at Al-Amarah University College. Our department stands as a pioneering center in education and scientific research, dedicated to delivering distinguished education that keeps pace with rapid technological advancements while equipping our students with the essential knowledge and skills required to face security challenges in the digital age.
In the Department of Cybersecurity Engineering Technology, we believe in the importance of continuous innovation and development. We work tirelessly to advance scientific research and foster collaboration with public and private institutions to achieve our goals. Through our advanced academic programs and well-equipped laboratories, we aim to prepare graduates capable of efficiently protecting systems and information, contributing to the enhancement of cybersecurity at both national and international levels.
We always aspire to achieve leadership in cybersecurity and strive to spread awareness regarding the vital importance of this field. We firmly believe that academic knowledge and practical training are the keys to developing the expertise needed to counter growing cyber threats.
I invite you to take full advantage of all the educational and training opportunities we provide, and I wish you a fruitful and successful academic experience in our department.
May Peace, Mercy, and Blessings of Allah be upon you.
dept.cybersecurity_eng.vision:
*Academic and Scientific Leadership: Striving to deliver high-quality education that keeps pace with the latest developments in cybersecurity, while attaining a prestigious standing nationally and globally as leaders in education and research.
*Continuous Innovation and Advancement: Fostering innovation and developing new cybersecurity technologies that contribute to high-efficiency data and information protection, while developing students' skills to become creative innovators.
*Strategic Partnerships: Building robust collaborative relationships with public, private, and research institutions to enhance students' practical capabilities and provide effective security solutions to the community.
*Ethical and Professional Commitment: Promoting ethical values and professional standards across all aspects of education, training, and research to ensure the graduation of responsible professionals committed to cybersecurity ethics.
*Excellence in Community Service: Raising security awareness among community members by offering consultancies, workshops, and educational lectures, thereby enhancing information security at the societal level.
*Future-Oriented Approach: Looking ahead to anticipate emerging cyber challenges and developing proactive strategies and solutions to counter them.
dept.cybersecurity_eng.mission:
*Preparing Qualified Graduates: Delivering advanced educational programs that enable students to acquire the technical knowledge and skills required to become cybersecurity experts capable of defending information and systems against cyber threats.
*Innovation in Scientific Research: Encouraging advanced research and studies in cybersecurity to expand knowledge and develop new technologies that enhance data and information protection.
*Community Collaboration: Strengthening relationships with institutions and corporations to ensure a hands-on learning and training environment that elevates cybersecurity standards both locally and internationally.
*Spreading Security Awareness: Educating students and community members on the importance of cybersecurity and cyberattack prevention methods through workshops, lectures, and outreach activities.
*Enhancing the Learning Environment: Providing a stimulating educational environment that fosters creativity and critical thinking, enabling students to learn in specialized laboratories equipped with modern cybersecurity tools and technologies.
*Curriculum Development: Continuously updating and refining academic curricula to align with rapid technological advancements and evolving cybersecurity practices, ensuring the delivery of high-quality education.
dept.cybersecurity_eng.goals:
*Qualifying Cybersecurity Specialists: Preparing qualified and distinguished graduates in cybersecurity who are capable of protecting systems and sensitive data from various cyber threats.
*Advancing Knowledge and Scientific Research: Fostering scientific research in cybersecurity by encouraging students and faculty members to conduct innovative studies that drive the field forward.
*Collaborating with Institutions and Industry: Strengthening relationships with government bodies and private companies to provide practical and training opportunities for students, preparing them for the labor market.
*Promoting Security Awareness: Spreading awareness about the importance of cybersecurity among students and the broader community through organized workshops and educational lectures.
*Developing Innovative Curricula: Designing modern academic curricula aligned with rapid technological and cybersecurity developments to ensure students acquire essential knowledge and skills.
*Providing a Stimulating Educational Environment: Creating an encouraging learning atmosphere that supports creativity and critical thinking through well-equipped laboratories and advanced tools.
dept.cybersecurity_eng.about: The Department of Cybersecurity Engineering Technology at Al-Amarah University College was established to serve as a specialized academic institution dedicated to safeguarding digital infrastructure and information systems. The introduction of this department comes in response to rapid technological advancements, global digital transformation, and the escalating cyber threats and challenges accompanying them. The department aims to prepare distinguished engineers possessing theoretical knowledge and practical skills in cutting-edge cryptography, penetration testing, network security, and digital forensics, thereby serving the growing needs of governmental bodies, the private sector, and local and international labor markets.
